# Instinctive Pounce (`features:barbarian-instinctive-pounce`)
**Class:** [Barbarian](../classes/barbarian.md) | **Level:** [Barbarian 7](../levels/barbarian-7.md)

As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.
